project_type: Tauri v2 desktop app: Rust workspace (crates under hybrid-orchestrator/crates/) + React 18 / TypeScript webview (hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/, Vite + Zustand + Vitest + Testing Library). No component library; design tokens in frontend/src/styles/tokens.css (harbor blue, light+dark) and app.css.
build_system: Cargo workspace (hybrid-orchestrator/Cargo.toml) with an offline default workspace that EXCLUDES the tauri-app crate (it needs crates.io for `tauri`); npm/Vite for the frontend. NOTE: the tauri-app crate is built only in CI (crates.io reachable). Formatting is PER-CRATE, never `cargo fmt --all`.
test_framework: Rust: `cargo test` per crate with unit tests inline and integration tests under crates/*/tests/; providers use `wiremock` (MockServer) for HTTP mocking (see crates/providers/tests/adapters.rs). Frontend: Vitest + @testing-library/react; Tauri IPC mocked by vi.mock('@tauri-apps/api/core') routing invoke() per command; events via vi.mock('@tauri-apps/api/event'); dialog via vi.mock('@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog').
build_command: Frontend: cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm ci (or npm install) && npm run build (tsc + vite). Rust host-verifiable crates: cd hybrid-orchestrator && cargo build -p providers -p orchestrator-core -p routing -p persistence -p domain -p secrets -p engine -p mcp-client. The tauri-app crate builds only in CI.
test_command: Frontend: cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm run test (vitest run). Rust: cd hybrid-orchestrator && cargo test -p <crate> for each host-verifiable crate.
verification_instructions: SANDBOX IS INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (no crates.io/npm registry, no live Ollama/cloud/web endpoints). Cannot run cargo/npm installs, cannot build the tauri-app crate (needs `tauri` from crates.io), cannot hit live web-search endpoints. Real gates run in GitHub CI after push and true behavioral proof is the user's Windows build. Self-audit OFFLINE: per-crate `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -D warnings` where deps are already vendored, and frontend `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .`, `tsc`, eslint, vitest IF node_modules already present. If tooling is unavailable offline, rely on exhaustive manual self-review against the failure classes listed in environment_constraints.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No codegen for TS types: frontend/src/types/index.ts is hand-mirrored from Rust serde DTOs (crates/domain/src/models.rs and command view structs) with #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]. Any new/changed command requires: (1) the #[tauri::command] fn, (2) registration in crates/tauri-app/src/lib.rs generate_handler!, (3) an IPC wrapper in frontend/src/ipc/commands.ts, (4) a TS type in frontend/src/types/index.ts, all camelCase.
setup_instructions: Frontend deps live under hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/node_modules (may already be present). Rust deps under hybrid-orchestrator/target and the cargo registry cache. Do NOT attempt registry installs in-sandbox; if node_modules or the cargo cache is absent, note it and fall back to manual self-review. Start from a fresh branch off main.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network: crates.io + npm registry return 403; no Tauri CLI; no live Ollama/cloud/web endpoints. Cannot build the tauri-app crate in-sandbox (it depends on the external `tauri` crate). Web search CANNOT be verified live in-sandbox (no network) - it must be unit-tested with mocked HTTP (wiremock) and gated behind the composer toggle, degrading to a VISIBLE non-fatal notice when unconfigured or on failure (never a silent hang). EXHAUSTIVE CI SELF-AUDIT REQUIRED (past CI burned on these): Rust clippy -D warnings (no unused imports/vars, no needless_lifetimes, flat-prose doc comments, no useless_vec, no redundant clones); TS eslint no-unused-vars; tsc strict. EVERY vitest that mounts <App/>, the chat surface, Settings, or any component calling invoke() MUST mock ALL commands it now calls (send_message, list_available_models {models,errors}, provider_diagnostics, list_cloud_providers, list_local_runtimes, list_embedded_models, embedded_model_status, AND every NEW web-search/attach/repo command) with well-formed shapes. New store fields must be initialized in EVERY setState reset in tests (app.test.tsx resets useConversationsStore and useProvidersStore). Assertions after state changes use await findBy*/waitFor. When wrapping an input with help text, give the input an explicit aria-label so getByLabelText stays exact (this exact bug cost a CI cycle). Do NOT push/tag/PR - orchestrator publishes. Do NOT touch embedded engine feature-flagging/release bundle. Do NOT start the embedded folder-scan model-library rework (separate future task).
contribution_requirements: One coherent feature branch off main (internal commits/sub-delegations allowed, deliver one branch). Preserve v0.7.4 behavior: working Ollama enumeration + threaded chat, v0.7.4 send-failure visibility (sendState/sendError alert), provider Diagnostics panel, Enter-to-send / Shift+Enter newline (IME-safe). Update the spec (.kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/architecture.md Section 8.1 chat surface + new features + nav/welcome; note in tasks.md if appropriate). Secret hygiene (Section 9.1): plaintext key flows IN via a command, only an opaque SecretRef is stored; no command returns key material.
key_patterns: PIPELINE: send_message(conversationId, content, overrideRoute?) -> send_message_inner -> tokio::spawn run_turn; the message `content` is a plain String; run_turn persists a User Message {content: Text{text}}, builds ChatMessage history, routes, streams. The CLEANEST mechanism to inject attach/repo/web-search context is to prepend a bounded context block to the user message `content` before send (frontend assembles it, or a backend command reads files). COMMANDS: each #[tauri::command] has an `_inner` fn factored out for direct testing without a live Tauri State (established pattern). Provider-config mutations emit CoreEvent::ProvidersChanged on success (emit_providers_changed). SECRETS: SecretStore trait (store/resolve/delete/rotate); store(handle, plaintext) -> SecretRef; KEYCHAIN_SERVICE namespacing; KeyringSecretStore (prod) vs InMemorySecretStore (tests). set_cloud_provider_inner is the canonical mirror for a new set_web_search_provider: validate kind, store key as SecretRef under a stable per-kind handle, upsert config. CAPABILITIES: providers::Capabilities { streaming, tools, vision, json_mode, max_context } - use the `vision` flag to gate image attachments; AvailableModel carries capabilities so the frontend knows if the selected model supports vision. APPCONFIG: crates/persistence/src/config.rs AppConfig is versioned (schema_version=1), #[serde(flatten)] extra catch-all, additive #[serde(default)] fields - add a `web_search` config field here (additive). DIALOG: tauri-plugin-dialog already a dependency; frontend uses `import { open } from '@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog'` (see LocalRuntimesSection.tsx line 28/139, and its test mock in settings.test.tsx line 24). FS: to read attached/repo file contents natively, add Tauri commands using std::fs in the tauri-app crate (or tauri-plugin-fs) - decide and implement. ROUTING MODE: RoutingModeToggle currently 4 big segmented buttons in app.tsx between MessageList and Composer; must fold into the composer as a compact inline control. ERRORS: providers store `errors: ProviderEnumerationError[]` + `lastError`; currently ProviderEnumerationErrors renders always-on red text near the picker - replace with a warning-icon-in-composer -> small modal.
directory_structure: hybrid-orchestrator/crates/: domain (leaf DTOs), orchestrator-core (pipeline, session, permission, tools_bridge), providers (adapters + capability + registry, wiremock tests), routing (policies), persistence (config, db, repositories), secrets (SecretStore + SecretRef), mcp-client, engine (embedded), tauri-app (commands.rs ~5000 lines, lib.rs generate_handler!, state.rs AppState, events.rs bridge). hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/: app.tsx (shell: sidebar nav Chat/History/Settings + main pane), features/{chat,model-selector,history,settings,agent-editor,tool-manager}, state/ (zustand stores), ipc/ (commands.ts wrappers, events.ts), types/index.ts (hand-mirrored), styles/ (tokens.css, app.css), assets/logo.svg.
